SCIED 458.name: Teaching Science in the Elementary School
SCIED 458.description: Methods for teaching science in elementary school. Bulletin also requires 4th-semester standing, which the planner schema does not model directly.

SCIED 411W.name: Teaching Secondary Science I
SCIED 411W.description: Introductory methods course for prospective secondary science educators (grades 7-12): curriculum, learning theory, assessment, and reflective teaching practice. Bulletin also requires 5th-semester standing, which the planner schema does not model directly.

SCIED 412.name: Teaching Secondary Science II
SCIED 412.description: Second sequential methods course: planning, delivering, and assessing science instruction, run concurrently with supervised field experience in middle or secondary schools.
